text:
No option can be put forward yet, because the £400k annual-salary constraint was not testable in this analysis.

- The comparison is **very low robustness** and rests on three Olumi-supplied inputs rather than your evidence: delivery capacity, onboarding load, and annual salary spend.
- The model did compare all four scenarios, but it could not align its modelled salary-spend changes with the £400k/year limit; budget compliance was therefore left unscored.
- The goal’s direction and threshold frame are also unspecified, so the analysis cannot establish whether any scenario actually ships by Q3 within budget.
